scenes.visual: close-up photo of the black nylon brush strip running along the bottom of a shopping mall escalator's steel side panel, one white sneaker standing on the step beside it, low angle, sharp focus on the brush

narration.en: You've been using this escalator brush wrong your whole life.
narration.hi: Escalator pe ye brush dekha hai? Aap isse poori zindagi *galat* use kar rahe ho.

scenes.visual: photo of a young Indian man on a mall escalator lifting one foot to rub his shoe against the black brush strip on the escalator's side panel, side view, full body, natural pose

narration.en: Most people rub their shoes on it, like it's a free shoe polish.
narration.hi: Zyada tar log isse joote ragadte hain, jaise ye free ka *shoe polish* ho.

scenes.visual: macro photo looking straight down at the edge of a moving escalator step: the yellow step edge, a thin dark gap, then the black brush strip on the silver side panel

narration.en: Its real name is a *skirt deflector*. It guards a tiny gap between the moving steps and the side wall.
narration.hi: Iska asli naam hai *skirt deflector*. Ye moving steps aur side wall ke beech ke chhote se gap ko guard karta hai.

scenes.visual: close-up photo of an untied shoelace trailing on an escalator step right at the side edge, next to the black brush strip, tense dramatic light

narration.en: That gap can grab a shoelace, a dupatta, or a small finger, and pull it in.
narration.hi: Ye gap joote ki lace, dupatta, ya bachche ki ungli tak ko *kheench* sakta hai.

scenes.visual: photo of a child's small pink plastic clog standing on a metal escalator step, a Tokyo train station softly blurred behind

narration.en: In Japan, shoes got stuck in escalators 65 times in just six months. About half were soft plastic shoes, often on small kids.
narration.hi: Japan mein sirf chhe mahine mein *65 baar* joote escalator mein phanse. Inmein se aadhe soft plastic wale joote the, aksar chhote bachchon ke.

scenes.visual: photo of a smiling Indian family of three standing in the middle of the escalator steps, holding the handrail, bright modern mall

narration.en: The bristles nudge your foot away from the edge. So stand in the middle, and never polish your shoes on it.
narration.hi: Ye brush aapke pair ko edge se door rakhta hai. Toh hamesha *beech mein* khade raho, aur isse joote mat chamkao.

scenes.visual: photo of two young Indian friends laughing at a phone screen in a bright shopping mall, an escalator blurred behind them

narration.en: Know someone who still polishes their shoes here? Send them this. And comment NEXT for one more everyday thing we all get wrong.
narration.hi: Koi dost hai jo yahan joote chamkata hai? Usse ye bhejo. Aur aisi aur cheezein jaan-ni hain toh comment mein NEXT likho.
